notes: SDT was revised/finalized 3/27/2024; the second (non-struck) figure on each line is used, and lines struck with no replacement (bidet hose 45, outlet 15, hinge 25, doorstop 10) are omitted as zero. Revised lines sum exactly to 2,857. No tenant ledger in the folder: 'Unpaid charges 159.90' has no breakdown (recurring waiver 43, RBP 27, sanitation 39.65 total 109.65 does not explain it), so low confidence other_fee. Holdover: lease ended 2/29/2024, SDT move-out 3/3/2024 (sheet says 3/4); 222.10 equals exactly 3 days of March rent. Several SDT amounts equal the Turnkey Pros estimate figures (350, 375, 50, 80, 150) but the SDT is the PM's final statement, not an estimate, and no invoices were provided. The 7,780 estimate was not used. Ozone for smoke/other odors classified cleaning (no pet evidence; lease prohibits pets). Flooring line has no invoice or photos and the vendor said it could not do the flooring.
